title: Build model evaluation harness and cost-quality metrics
description: Create an evaluation harness for model/profile quality gates. It should test long-campaign continuity, canon preservation, NPC consistency, rules adjudication, structured output reliability, memory update quality, tool-use reliability, cost per turn/session, and latency.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run scripted scenarios against a ModelClient/profile; records continuity/canon/NPC/rules/structured-output/memory/tool-use scores plus cost and latency metrics; premium_dm pass/fail threshold is explicit and documented.
close_reason: Added model evaluation harness with scripted ModelClient/profile runs, seven quality dimension scores, cost/latency reporting, and premium_dm threshold pass/fail; verification passed.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Worktree baseline: npm install succeeded; npm run typecheck passed; initial npm run test failed before build because @loreweaver/core dist entry was absent; npm run build passed; npm run test passed after build with 157 passed / 1 skipped.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Verification: npm run typecheck -> passed; npm run build -> passed; npm run test -> 158 passed / 1 skipped. Acceptance check: scripted scenarios run against ModelClient/profile; report records all seven quality dimensions plus cost and latency; premium_dm threshold is exported as PREMIUM_DM_EVALUATION_THRESHOLD and drives pass/fail.
